body.message: Perfect, Matias. To confirm everything: AED 8,000/month, AED 24,000 for 3 months all-inclusive, July 1st to September 30th. Payment structure is fine, first two months upfront and the third before end of August. We have your email and passport copies. I'll get the contract drawn up now and send it over to griszka1999@gmail.com shortly.
